newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo shaken by moderate tremor.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo shaken by moderate tremor.

text.p: Office buildings in Tokyo were shaken by a moderate tremor on Sunday.
There was no immediate indication of its magnitude.
The earthquake occurred at 2:51 p.m. (0551 GMT) and was centred in the western Japanese district of Kinki, about 300 km (180 miles) west of Tokyo, NHK public broadcasting reported.
Large areas of central and eastern Japan were shaken by the earthquake, which shook office buildings in central Tokyo for about 10 seconds.
No details on damage were immediately available.
